episodes.synopsis: Tomoka's father forbids her from attending the upcoming festival, and does not approve of her playing basketball. Subaru offers to speak with him.
episodes.title: Innocent World!

episodes.synopsis: Tomoka has a one-on-one match with Mimi. Mimi and Kagetsu go to Takenaka for help to form a new team of 5th graders to play against the 6th graders.
episodes.title: Flying Battle!

episodes.synopsis: The 5th graders show off the results of their talent and training under Subaru's father in an earnest match against the 6th grade team.
episodes.title: Paradigm Ginga

episodes.synopsis: As the 6th graders prepare to practice, Subaru encounters his old rival who coaches a middle school team. He challenges them to a three-on-three game.
episodes.title: The Stupid Boy

episodes.synopsis: Subaru, Airi, and Tomoka train hard for their rematch against Ryuichi's team with coaching from Banri, Takenaka, and most importantly, each other.
episodes.title: Overnight Sensation!

episodes.synopsis: Subaru and Aoi win a trip for two to Kyoto that coincidentally falls on the same dates as the 6th graders' school field trip to the city.
episodes.title: Aoi Wins?

episodes.synopsis: Maho's father invites Subaru and the team to a party and asks them if there is anything he can do for them. After thinking a moment, Subaru responds.
episodes.title: Win, again?

episodes.synopsis: The 5th and 6th grade teams face off in an exciting match in which they keep adjusting their strategies to get ahead as their coaches cheer them on.
episodes.title: I Wish with You

episodes.synopsis: Saki and Masami get into a culinary duel at a food fair, assisted by their respective teams, when they suddenly encounter Rena from Suzuridani.
episodes.title: Don't Wanna Cry

episodes.synopsis: The 5th and 6th graders join up to train each other for an upcoming tournament, where the Suzuridani team looks forward to their match together.
episodes.title: Wanna Be A Playmaker

episodes.synopsis: In an emotional match between Keishin and Suzuridani at the tournament, the 5th graders are fired up at the chance to prove themselves against Rena.
episodes.title: Dearests

episodes.synopsis: The game goes into overtime, and the 6th grade team gets substituted in to show what they can do. But Suzuridani promises to fight back, too.
episodes.title: Because You're Here, Tomoka
